AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app manages coffee orders and wardrobe items. Operational Patterns: - Use 'orderCoffee' to place a coffee order. - Use 'saveWardrobeItem' to add an item to the wardrobe. - Use 'viewOrder' to retrieve the details of an order. Constraints: - Coffee size must be one of Small, Medium, Large. - Wardrobe item name must not be empty.
